hypothesis: A contamination-aware three-fold harness with Fold C frozen at Re 5025/16500/22875/25425 will refuse to rank a method on a fold whose Reynolds groups appear in that method's training files, and persist-first-4 will beat its CNO base on Rel-L2, TKE, MVPE, and calibrated SPS on every clean fold.
comparator: persistence on each fold; ranking uses only clean-fold deltas versus persistence and versus the method's own CNO base

interval.note: Frozen E006/E008/E009 interval; recomputed on hybrid predictions

controls: Fold C membership is frozen before Fold C field values are loaded
k=4 is frozen from the E011 review and is not retuned here
E005/E008 may be ranked only on Fold A
E010 may be ranked only on Fold B
Fold C learned scores are not computed in E012
Codabench scores are not used for selection
promotion: protocol only; do not package or submit from E012
limitations: E005 and E010 are different checkpoints, so Fold A and Fold B clean rows are not the same model.
The unpublished official final_score is not reconstructed.
Local time scores remain RTX 5050 measurements and are not Codabench-comparable.
